title: agentsearch secrets
description: Flat provider-credential map read from ~/.config/agentsearch/secrets.json (AGENTSEARCH_CONFIG_DIR relocates it). Resolution is environment-first: a non-empty environment variable of the same name always wins over this file; the file leg exists so credentials resolve under hooks and daemons that inherit no shell profile. Keep the file chmod 600 — every value is a credential.

$schema.description: Reserved for editor tooling; ignored by agentsearch.

PERPLEXITY_API_KEY.description: Perplexity API key used by `agentsearch ask` and `agentsearch find`. Every call bills against it.

additionalProperties.description: Any additional credential, resolved by exact name. An empty or non-string value means "no credential" rather than an error.
